faqs.question: When is the first day of school in Gilchrist County for 2026-2027?
faqs.answer: The first student day is Tuesday, August 11, 2026. Teacher preplanning takes place before that date.

faqs.question: When is the last day of school in Gilchrist County in 2027?
faqs.answer: Friday, May 28, 2027 is the last student day. It is also a final-exam day with early release and the end of Quarter 4.

faqs.question: Does the 2026-2027 calendar cover Bell and Trenton schools?
faqs.answer: Yes. This page covers Gilchrist County School District's regular student calendar for Bell High School, Bell Elementary School, Trenton High School and Trenton Elementary School. School-specific events or separate program schedules may differ.

faqs.question: When is open house for the 2026-2027 school year?
faqs.answer: The district calendar lists Open House on Thursday, August 6, 2026, during teacher preplanning. Contact your child's school for its visiting hours and arrangements.

faqs.question: When is Fall Break in Gilchrist County in 2026?
faqs.answer: Fall Break is November 23–25, 2026. It is followed by the separately named Thanksgiving Holiday on November 26–27, giving students the full school week off. Classes are scheduled to resume Monday, November 30.

faqs.question: When is Thanksgiving break in Gilchrist County in 2026?
faqs.answer: The district lists November 26–27, 2026 as Thanksgiving Holiday. Because Fall Break runs November 23–25, students have no regular classes November 23–27.

faqs.question: When is Christmas Break, and when do students return to school?
faqs.answer: Christmas Break runs December 21, 2026–January 1, 2027. Teacher workdays on January 4–6 keep students out of class until Thursday, January 7. Including weekends, the full stretch without regular classes is December 19–January 6.

faqs.question: Do students attend school on the January 5 Close the Gap day?
faqs.answer: No. January 5, 2027 is marked as a teacher workday and student holiday. Students also have January 4 and 6 off and return January 7.

faqs.question: When is Fair Break in Gilchrist County in 2027?
faqs.answer: Fair Break is Monday, March 15 through Wednesday, March 17, 2027. Classes are scheduled to resume Thursday, March 18. This is separate from April's Spring Break.

faqs.question: When is Spring Break in Gilchrist County for 2027?
faqs.answer: Spring Break is April 12–16, 2027, with classes scheduled to resume Monday, April 19.

faqs.question: Is there school on Good Friday, March 26, 2027?
faqs.answer: Yes. Gilchrist County's calendar marks Good Friday, March 26, as an early-release school day, not a full day off. Ask your school for the dismissal time.

faqs.question: What are the early-release dates for 2026-2027?
faqs.answer: The nine early-release dates are September 16 and October 14, 2026; December 17–18, 2026; March 3 and March 26, 2027; and May 26–28, 2027. The December and May dates coincide with exams.

faqs.question: What time is early dismissal in Gilchrist County schools?
faqs.answer: The district's annual calendar lists early-release dates but not dismissal times. Check with your child's school for its bell schedule, bus pickup and after-school arrangements.

faqs.question: When are midterm exams in 2026?
faqs.answer: Midterm exams are scheduled for December 17–18, 2026, with early release on both days. Quarter 2 ends December 18. Ask your school which exams apply to your child.

faqs.question: When are final exams in 2027?
faqs.answer: Final exams are scheduled for May 26–28, 2027. All three dates have early release, and May 28 is the last student day. Check with your school for individual exam schedules.

faqs.question: Which teacher workdays are student holidays?
faqs.answer: Students have no regular classes on October 23, 2026; January 4–6, 2027; and February 16, 2027. These dates are marked as teacher workdays and student holidays on the district calendar.

faqs.question: Is there school on Labor Day in 2026?
faqs.answer: No. Gilchrist County schools are closed to students on Monday, September 7, 2026 for Labor Day.

faqs.question: Is there school on Veterans Day in 2026?
faqs.answer: No. Wednesday, November 11, 2026 is marked as a no-school holiday on the district calendar.

faqs.question: Is there school on Martin Luther King Jr. Day in 2027?
faqs.answer: No. Gilchrist County students have Monday, January 18, 2027 off for Martin Luther King Jr. Day.

faqs.question: Is there school on Presidents Day in 2027?
faqs.answer: No. Students are off Monday, February 15, 2027 for Presidents Day and Tuesday, February 16 for a teacher workday. With the preceding weekend, they have four consecutive days off, February 13–16. Classes are scheduled to resume February 17.

faqs.question: When are parent-teacher conferences in 2026-2027?
faqs.answer: The district lists conference windows of October 12–15, 2026 and January 25–28, 2027. Contact your child's school for the actual conference night and appointment time. These windows do not cancel regular classes.

faqs.question: Is there school on Columbus Day, October 12, 2026?
faqs.answer: The Gilchrist County calendar does not list Monday, October 12, 2026 as a no-school day. It falls within the October 12–15 parent-conference window, which does not itself cancel classes. Check school announcements for any schedule changes.

faqs.question: When do the grading quarters end in 2026-2027?
faqs.answer: Quarter 1 ends October 9, 2026; Quarter 2 ends December 18, 2026; Quarter 3 ends March 12, 2027; and Quarter 4 ends May 28, 2027. The Quarter 2 and Quarter 4 end dates also have early release.

faqs.question: When are progress reports scheduled in 2026-2027?
faqs.answer: The district lists progress reports for September 11 and November 12, 2026, and February 17 and April 21, 2027. Check with your school for how and when to access your child's report.

faqs.question: When are report cards issued in 2026-2027?
faqs.answer: Report-card dates are October 16, 2026; January 8, 2027; March 19, 2027; and June 1, 2027. The June 1 date comes after the last student day and does not extend the school year.

faqs.question: When is Bell High School graduation in 2027?
faqs.answer: Bell High School graduation is scheduled for Thursday, May 20, 2027. Contact the school for the ceremony time, location, rehearsal and guest arrangements. The district calendar does not list a separate last day for seniors.

faqs.question: When is Trenton High School graduation in 2027?
faqs.answer: Trenton High School graduation is scheduled for Friday, May 21, 2027. Ask the school for ceremony details and senior arrangements. The district calendar does not specify a separate senior last day.

faqs.question: How many student attendance days are in the 2026-2027 calendar?
faqs.answer: The published dates yield 177 planned attendance weekdays: 209 weekdays between August 11 and May 28, minus 32 confirmed no-school weekdays. This is a calculation from the calendar, not an official annual total printed by the district. Early-release days are included.

faqs.question: Where can I find the official 2026-2027 school calendar PDF?
faqs.answer: The Gilchrist County School District's School Calendars page links its official 2026-2027 PDF. Use that page and district or school announcements to check for later schedule changes.

faqs.question: Does the 2026-2027 calendar list weather make-up days?
faqs.answer: The published district PDF does not identify reserved weather make-up dates. Check district and school announcements if weather or another emergency affects the regular schedule.

faqs.question: When is the last day of school in Gilchrist County in 2028?
faqs.answer: Friday, May 26, 2028 is the last student day. The calendar also lists final exams, early release and the end of Quarter 4 on that date.

faqs.question: Does the 2027-2028 calendar cover Bell and Trenton schools?
faqs.answer: Yes. This page covers Gilchrist County School District's regular student calendar for Bell High School, Bell Elementary School, Trenton High School and Trenton Elementary School. School-specific events or separate program schedules may differ.

faqs.question: When is open house for the 2027-2028 school year?
faqs.answer: The district's 2027-2028 calendar does not list an open-house date. Check Bell or Trenton school announcements for back-to-school event details.

faqs.question: When is Fall Break in Gilchrist County in 2027?
faqs.answer: Fall Break runs November 22–24, 2027. The separately named Thanksgiving Holiday follows November 25–26, giving students the full school week off. Classes are scheduled to resume Monday, November 29.

faqs.question: When is Thanksgiving break in Gilchrist County in 2027?
faqs.answer: Thanksgiving Holiday is November 25–26, 2027. Combined with Fall Break on November 22–24, students have no regular classes November 22–26.

faqs.question: When is Christmas Break, and when do students return in January 2028?
faqs.answer: Christmas Break runs December 20, 2027–January 3, 2028. Teacher workdays on January 4–7 extend students' time off, and classes resume Monday, January 10. Including weekends, the full break from regular classes lasts December 18–January 9, or 23 consecutive days.

faqs.question: Is January 7, 2028 a school day for students?
faqs.answer: No. Friday, January 7 is a teacher workday and student holiday. Although the grading-period table starts Quarter 3 on January 7, the daily calendar marks it as a day without student classes. Students return January 10.

faqs.question: Do students attend the January 5, 2028 Close the Gap day?
faqs.answer: No regular student classes are scheduled January 5, 2028. Close the Gap is listed as a teacher workday and student holiday, within the January 4–7 student days off.

faqs.question: When is Fair Break in Gilchrist County in 2028?
faqs.answer: Fair Break is March 13–15, 2028, Monday through Wednesday. Classes are scheduled to resume Thursday, March 16. It is separate from April's Spring Break.

faqs.question: When is Spring Break in Gilchrist County in 2028?
faqs.answer: The district's named Spring Break is April 10–13, 2028. Good Friday on April 14 is a separate school holiday, so students have the full week of April 10–14 off. Classes are scheduled to resume Monday, April 17.

faqs.question: Is there school on Good Friday, April 14, 2028?
faqs.answer: No. Good Friday, April 14, 2028 is a full no-school holiday in Gilchrist County. It follows Spring Break on April 10–13 and is not an early-release day.

faqs.question: What are the early-release dates for 2027-2028?
faqs.answer: The eight early-release dates are September 15 and October 13, 2027; December 16–17, 2027; February 23, 2028; and May 24–26, 2028. Good Friday on April 14 is a full day off and is not counted as early release.

faqs.question: What time is early dismissal in Gilchrist County schools?
faqs.answer: The district calendar identifies early-release dates but does not publish dismissal times. Ask your child's school for the bell schedule, bus service and pickup arrangements.

faqs.question: When are midterm exams in 2027?
faqs.answer: Midterm exams are scheduled for December 16–17, 2027. Both dates have early release, and Quarter 2 ends December 17. Check with your school for individual exam schedules.

faqs.question: When are final exams in 2028?
faqs.answer: Final exams are scheduled for May 24–26, 2028, with early release on all three dates. Friday, May 26 is also the last student day.

faqs.question: Which teacher workdays are student holidays in 2027-2028?
faqs.answer: Students have no regular classes on October 15, 2027; January 4–7, 2028; and February 15, 2028. These are the teacher workdays and student holidays listed within the regular school year.

faqs.question: Is there school on Labor Day in 2027?
faqs.answer: No. Monday, September 6, 2027 is a no-school holiday for Labor Day.

faqs.question: Is there school on Veterans Day in 2027?
faqs.answer: No. Gilchrist County students have Thursday, November 11, 2027 off for Veterans Day. Friday, November 12 is not marked as a student holiday on the district calendar.

faqs.question: Is there school on Martin Luther King Jr. Day in 2028?
faqs.answer: No. Monday, January 17, 2028 is listed as a no-school holiday for Martin Luther King Jr. Day.

faqs.question: When is the Presidents Day school holiday in 2028?
faqs.answer: Gilchrist County's calendar lists Monday, February 14, 2028 as its Presidents Day no-school date, followed by a teacher workday on February 15. Students are scheduled to return February 16. The federal holiday falls on February 21, but the district PDF does not list February 21 as a student holiday.

faqs.question: When are parent-teacher conferences in 2027-2028?
faqs.answer: The district lists conference windows of October 11–14, 2027 and February 7–11, 2028. Contact your school for the actual conference date and appointment time. The windows themselves do not cancel regular classes.

faqs.question: Is there school on Columbus Day, October 11, 2027?
faqs.answer: October 11 is not marked as a student holiday on Gilchrist County's 2027–2028 calendar. It falls within the parent-conference window, which does not itself cancel classes. Although the grading table starts Quarter 2 on October 12, it does not establish October 11 as a day off.

faqs.question: When do the four grading quarters end in 2027-2028?
faqs.answer: Quarter 1 ends October 8, 2027; Quarter 2 ends December 17, 2027; Quarter 3 ends March 10, 2028; and Quarter 4 ends May 26, 2028. December 17 and May 26 also have early release.

faqs.question: When are progress reports scheduled in 2027-2028?
faqs.answer: The calendar lists September 11 and November 12, 2027, and February 16 and April 19, 2028. September 11 falls on a Saturday. Check with your school about report availability; the reporting date does not mean students attend Saturday classes.

faqs.question: When are report cards issued in 2027-2028?
faqs.answer: The listed report-card dates are October 14, 2027; January 14, 2028; March 17, 2028; and June 1, 2028. The final report-card date is after the May 26 last student day.

faqs.question: When is Trenton High School graduation in 2028?
faqs.answer: Trenton High School graduation is scheduled for Thursday, May 18, 2028. Contact the school for ceremony time, location, rehearsal and guest information. The district calendar does not give a separate senior last day.

faqs.question: When is Bell High School graduation in 2028?
faqs.answer: Bell High School graduation is scheduled for Friday, May 19, 2028. Ask the school for ceremony details and senior arrangements. The district calendar does not specify a separate senior last day.

faqs.question: How many student attendance days are in the 2027-2028 calendar?
faqs.answer: The published dates yield 175 planned attendance weekdays: 209 weekdays between August 10 and May 26, minus 34 confirmed no-school weekdays. This is a calculation from the calendar rather than an official annual total printed by the district. Early-release days are included.

faqs.question: Where can I find the official 2027-2028 school calendar PDF?
faqs.answer: The Gilchrist County School District's School Calendars page links the official 2027-2028 PDF. Check that page and district or school announcements for later changes.

faqs.question: Does the 2027-2028 calendar list weather make-up days?
faqs.answer: The district's published PDF does not designate reserved weather make-up dates. Check district announcements if weather or another emergency leads to a schedule change.
